ai_review.summary: Decent but somewhat distant recording captures a pretty good show highlighted by Bird Song.
ai_review.review: The upload offers a decent, slightly distant‑sounding capture that still lets the performance shine. Reviewers describe the concert as "pretty good" with Bird Song standing out as a highlight, even planning to open a radio show with it. While the audio isn’t crystal‑clear, it’s listenable enough for fans who have waited years for this material.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; reviewer gave 4 stars and praised the show while noting only modest recording quality, leading to a solid but not exceptional overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent recording but with a distant feel typical of Shoreline captures; clarity is acceptable though not crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall pretty good performance; no specific criticisms about pacing or flow were mentioned.
